subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Is test-only proof enough for this session-state prompt repair, or must the PR show real embedded-agent output before merge?
rationale: The diff changes provider-visible prompt repair and active transcript state, and the contributor explicitly could not run the live embedded-agent cases that repository policy expects for this kind of bug fix.
